finding.message: src/presentation/shipment.controller.ts (presentation) skips layers to import src/persistence/shipment.repository.ts (persistence)

answer.explanation: ShipmentController (presentation) imports and is constructor-injected with ShipmentRepository (persistence), skipping the business layer. It calls repo.markReturned directly in registerReturn, so a state change happens in the controller without going through ShipmentService. FF-S03 flags presentation reaching persistence without passing through the layer between them. The material provided has no docs, ADRs or comments declaring a layering rule or an exception for this case.

ShipmentController, in the presentation layer, imports and is constructor-injected with ShipmentRepository from the persistence layer. It calls repo.markReturned directly in registerReturn. That skips the business layer (ShipmentService), which the controller already uses for create. FF-S03 flags this because presentation should reach persistence only through the business layer. Here the shortcut changes state (marks a shipment as returned) and so puts business logic in the controller instead of a service. No docs, ADRs or comments were provided that declare a rule or grant an exception for this case.
